intro.lookAtPlayer: Look at a player to introduce yourself.
intro.introducedOneWay: You introduced yourself. They must introduce themselves for you to learn their name.

examine.nobodyLikeThat: You see nobody like that nearby.
examine.nobodyClose: There is nobody close enough to examine.

staff.callCooldown: You contacted the staff recently, try again in {seconds} seconds.
staff.callSent: Your message was sent to the staff.

chat.systemDenied: You do not have permission to use /system.
chat.adminDenied: You do not have permission to use the admin channel.
chat.help: Chat: plain text talks nearby. /low /whisper /wide change range, /me /my /do emote, /looc out of character, /shout carries, /pm <name> <msg>, /roll [NdM], /mask hides your name, /gm /ticket /pray <msg> reach the staff.

mask.removeFailed: Could not remove the mask, try again.
mask.cannotMask: Your name cannot be masked right now.
mask.maskFailed: Could not mask your name, try again.
mask.masked: You are now masked as "{name}". Use /mask again to remove it.

pm.unknownToThem: They do not know you. Introduce yourself in person first.

lookup.ambiguous: "{query}" matches several players: {names}. Be more specific.

combat.critTaken: You took a critical hit: {damage} damage.
combat.gearUnreadable: That gear cannot be read right now.

repair.cannotOpen: The repair menu cannot be opened right now.

help.title: Gamemode console commands:
help.say: say <text>                 server broadcast into every chat tab
help.admin: admin list|add <profileId>|remove <profileId>   runtime chat admins (not persisted)
help.revive: revive <formDesc>          return a fallen character (Sovngarde, Soul Cairn, perma-dead) to the living

console.reviveTooOld: server code too old: build the server and restart the game service
console.reviveUsage: usage: revive <formDesc>  (the character id the Players tab shows, e.g. 97)
console.revived: revived {id}, they wake at the Temple of Kynareth
console.kickReason: You were kicked from the server by an admin.
console.spellUsage: usage: {verb} <name> <0xFormId>  (hex form id, e.g. 92c48 for Beast Form)
console.adminNone: no runtime admin overrides (backend admin.* permissions still apply)
console.adminUsage: usage: admin list | admin add <profileId> | admin remove <profileId>
